events.headline: Samsung Wallet to launch USDC transfers on Solana for 82M US Galaxy devices from last week of October (Coinbase custody via Bastion)
events.relevance: Counterparty-announced consumer payments rail on Solana at scale (82M US devices); USDC volume/activity benefit for the chain, though SOL's direct role (fees) is not stated, and SOL is NEAR with price above the entry zone.

events.headline: Polkadot goes live with dotUSD stablecoin under DOT DAO governance (Referendum 1944; USDT peg-stability minting, initial supply cap)
events.relevance: Escalation of the queued Tier-2 'launch unconfirmed' item: dotUSD is now reported live on mainnet with a native USDT-backed mint/redeem path (DOT-collateral phase later), a new utility/fee channel for DOT while DOT sits NEAR the entry zone.

events.headline: Ledger launches Bitcoin-backed loans in Ledger Wallet via Morpho (cbBTC/wBTC collateral, borrow USDC/USDT)
events.relevance: New distribution channel: Ledger's wallet base can now borrow against BTC through Morpho markets, adding protocol usage/fee flow for a held coin.

events.headline: 9.92M HYPE (~$856M, ~4.5% of 222.45M circulating) unlocks to core contributors on Oct 6, 2026
events.eventClass: scheduled vesting unlock >= 2% of circulating within 7 days (scheduled, not an observed sale)
events.relevance: Supply overhang lands today on a held coin near the entry zone; argues against adding above the zone until absorption is visible.

events.headline: Hyperliquid Strategies (Nasdaq: PURR) buys another 1.9M HYPE for $167.2M; holdings ~37M HYPE
events.relevance: Largest HYPE treasury vehicle keeps absorbing supply (~0.5% of circulating in one buy); supports holding but does not by itself justify chasing above the entry zone.
